note: Template only. No actual flight has been assessed. Flight-readiness flags start false; the separately confirmed historical channel mapping is retained below.

rpm_input_mapping.provenance: Operator confirmed all aircraft/channel assignments unchanged from previous experiments. Mapping matches scripts/audit_dynamic_identifiability.py and fit_sun_dynamic_pitch.py.
rpm_input_mapping.application: For raw-data adapter: reorder channels once into motor order. Normalized rpm1..rpm4 already denote M1..M4; do not reorder them again.

normalization_contract.time_s: Common monotonic timeline in seconds; never align solely by filenames or wall clock.
normalization_contract.flag_encoding: Numeric 0/1. usable excludes documented acquisition defects, not model residuals.
normalization_contract.position: Motive mm must be converted to m; verify rigid-body point, world and body frame transforms.
normalization_contract.angles: roll_deg,pitch_deg,yaw_deg from correctly transformed MoCap quaternion, not PX4 Euler yaw substituted as truth.
normalization_contract.rates: p_deg_s,q_deg_s,r_deg_s are BODY angular rates, not Euler angle derivatives. Transform and synchronize the gyro.
normalization_contract.velocity: speed_m_s is horizontal ground speed magnitude; vz_m_s is NED vertical velocity; u_air_m_s is body-forward aircraft airspeed, R_NED_to_FRD*(v_ground-v_wind). No arbitrary beta at zero speed.
normalization_contract.differentiation: Document source capture rate, filtering and latency. 120-Hz export of 60-Hz capture is not independent 120-Hz observation. Do not differentiate across gaps.
normalization_contract.rpm: rpm1..rpm4 are measured RPM with verified pulses/revolution and motor mapping, not motor output or an estimate.
normalization_contract.commands: command1..command4 are normalized actual motor commands in [0,1]; voltage_v is measured battery voltage.
normalization_contract.flight_identity: recording_key identifies one physical flight, e.g. FC UID + boot epoch + flight UUID. Multiple sensor files or copied logs do not count as repeats.
normalization_contract.excluded_claims: Coverage does not establish model accuracy, transport reliability or permission to fly. No raw-file adapter or model fit is implemented here.
